measurementBoundary: Small synthetic regression corpora, not representative product quality or isolated model throughput.

ocr.normalization: Unicode NFC, LF line endings and outer whitespace only; repeated lines are preserved.
ocr.fieldAccuracy: Exact case-sensitive annotated label/value occurrences, not general semantic understanding.
ocr.captureMetadata: The original invocation records contain two empty PowerShell task-result objects followed by the invocation object. These original arrays are retained. The runner was subsequently corrected; answer strings, quality scores and timings were not rewritten.

timingNotes: Wall time includes command startup, routing, queueing and execution. A model-inventory request overlapped this run; no additional generative task was started during measurement. Search queue timing is unavailable. OCR queue/run fields are retained as reported and are not a full end-to-end decomposition.
modelManifestNotes: Manifest hashes identify files observed in the local model store, not an attestation of weights loaded by the backend.
tokenSavings: Search evaluation is administrative and has no applicable savings. OCR receipts report comparison_scenario_unknown for both cloud input and output tokens.
